evidence: Read the diff for all seven changed paths and found no defect this commit introduces.
The unreadable-page detection runs only after frontmatterBlock fails, so pages that were readable before are handled as they were.

Unreadable pages still go through the project-owner filter, so a page owned by another project is skipped and a page with no project lands in NoProject. The new unreadable test covers the 'away' and 'lost' cases.
The exit code now comes from report.Refused alone, as the commit claims, and the no-project note prints on stdout only.
The empty-type and empty-revision recovery candidates are added without dropping any earlier candidate, and the two new tests cover each.
syncDirectory no longer returns early on Windows, but toleratedDirectorySyncError still treats any Windows sync error as tolerated, so behaviour there is unchanged.
